verdict.rationale: The app documents bring-your-own-endpoint support for any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint, explicitly including self-hosted options (vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama), with the key stored in the Keychain and run history kept on the phone. That lets a user keep screenshots and goals away from third-party model providers that might train on them. However, the product never states a no-training or no-telemetry policy or offers a training opt-out, and protection depends on the user choosing and running a local endpoint. missing for 10: explicit statement that user data is never used for training, documented no-telemetry/data-handling policy, independent verification of data flows.
